articles.title_cn: 稳态社交距离与疫苗接种
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes an economic-epidemiological model of infectious disease where it is possible to become infected more than once and individual agents make endogenous choices of social distancing and vaccine adoption. Protective actions adopted by any one person reduce future risks to other people. The positive externalities associated with these behaviors provide motivation for vaccine and social-distancing subsidies, but subsidizing one protective action reduces incentives for other protective actions. A vaccine subsidy increases vaccine adoption and reduces steady-state infection prevalence; a social distancing subsidy can either increase or reduce steady-state infection prevalence. (JEL D62, D91, I12, I18)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了一个传染病的经济-流行病学模型，在该模型中，个体可能多次感染，并且个体代理人内生地选择社交距离和疫苗采用。任何一个人采取的保护性行动都会降低未来对其他人的风险。与这些行为相关的正外部性为疫苗和社交距离补贴提供了动机，但补贴一种保护性行动会减少对其他保护性行动的激励。疫苗补贴增加了疫苗采用并降低了稳态感染率；社交距离补贴可以增加或减少稳态感染率。（JEL D62, D91, I12, I18）

articles.title_en: Race and the Mismeasure of School Quality
articles.title_cn: 种族与学校质量的误测
articles.abstract_en: In large urban districts, schools enrolling more White students tend to have higher performance ratings. We use an instrumental variables strategy leveraging centralized school assignment to explore this relationship. Estimates from Denver and New York City suggest that the correlation between school performance ratings and White enrollment shares reflects selection bias rather than causal school value added. In fact, value added in these two cities is essentially unrelated to White enrollment shares. A simple regression adjustment is shown to yield school ratings uncorrelated with race while predicting value added as well as or better than the corresponding unadjusted measures. (JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15)
articles.abstract_cn: 在大型城市学区中，招收更多白人学生的学校往往获得更高的绩效评级。我们利用集中式学校分配的工具变量策略来探讨这一关系。来自丹佛和纽约市的估计表明，学校绩效评级与白人入学比例之间的相关性反映了选择偏差，而非因果性的学校增值。事实上，这两个城市的增值与白人入学比例基本无关。简单的回归调整被证明能产生与种族无关的学校评级，同时预测增值的效果与相应的未调整指标相当或更好。（JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15）

articles.title_en: Wage Garnishment in the United States: New Facts from Administrative Payroll Records
articles.title_cn: 美国的工资扣押：来自行政工资记录的新事实
articles.abstract_en: Wage garnishment allows creditors to deduct money from workers’ paychecks to repay defaulted debts. We document new facts about wage garnishment between 2014 and 2019 using data from a large payroll processor that distributes paychecks to approximately 20 percent of US private-sector workers. By 2019, over 1 in every 100 workers was being garnished for delinquent debt. The average garnished worker experiences garnishment for five months, during which approximately 11 percent of gross earnings is remitted to their creditor(s). The beginning of a garnishment is associated with an increase in job turnover but no intensive margin change in hours worked. (JEL G51, J22, J63)
articles.abstract_cn: 工资扣押允许债权人从工人的工资中扣除款项以偿还违约债务。我们利用一家大型工资处理机构的数据，记录了2014年至2019年间关于工资扣押的新事实，该机构向约20%的美国私营部门工人发放工资。到2019年，每100名工人中就有超过1人因拖欠债务而被扣押工资。平均被扣押工资的工人经历五个月的扣押期，在此期间，约11%的总收入被汇给其债权人。扣押工资的开始与工作流动性的增加有关，但在工作时间上没有集约边际的变化。(JEL G51, J22, J63)

articles.title_en: The Irrelevance of Fee Structures for Certification
articles.title_cn: 认证费用结构的无关性
articles.abstract_en: In models of certification, possible restrictions on the nature of the fee structures are commonly analyzed. We show that they are irrelevant for the certifier’s ability to maximize profits and trade efficiency. Our results establish that certification schemes involve two substitutable dimensions—the fee structure and the disclosure rule. In the context of a canonical unit good certification setup, these dimensions act as perfect substitutes for achieving trade efficiency and (monotone) distributions of rents; adjustments in the disclosure dimension can fully mitigate restrictions in the fee dimension, but these changes do affect market transparency. (JEL D82, D83, G24, G28)
articles.abstract_cn: 在认证模型中，通常会对费用结构的可能限制进行分析。我们证明这些限制对于认证者最大化利润和交易效率的能力是无关的。我们的结果确立了认证方案涉及两个可替代的维度——费用结构和披露规则。在典型的单位商品认证设置的背景下，这些维度在实现交易效率和（单调的）租金分配方面完全替代；披露维度的调整可以完全缓解费用维度的限制，但这些变化确实会影响市场透明度。（JEL D82, D83, G24, G28）

articles.title_en: Real Effects of Markets on Politics: Evidence from US Presidential Elections
articles.title_cn: 市场对政治的真实影响：来自美国总统选举的证据
articles.abstract_en: Despite the economic importance of the US stock market, there is strikingly little evidence of its impact on elections. Using county-level variation in stock market participation, we document the impact of market returns on election outcomes. High-participation counties are more likely to vote for the incumbent party when the market has performed well relative to low-participation counties. Our findings provide evidence of a novel channel through which stock market fluctuations could be transmitted into the real economy. (JEL D72, G12, G35, G41, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管美国股市具有经济重要性，但关于其对选举影响的证据却出奇地少。利用县级股市参与率的差异，我们记录了市场回报对选举结果的影响。当市场表现良好时，高参与率的县相比低参与率的县更有可能投票给现任政党。我们的发现提供了证据，表明股市波动可能通过一种新的渠道传导至实体经济。（JEL D72, G12, G35, G41, G51）

articles.title_en: Interest Rates and the Spatial Polarization of Housing Markets
articles.title_cn: 利率与住房市场的空间极化
articles.abstract_en: Rising within-country differences in house values are a much-debated trend in the United States and internationally. Using new long-run regional data for 15 advanced economies, we show that standard explanations linking growing price dispersion to rent dispersion are contradicted by an important stylized fact: rent dispersion has increased far less than price dispersion. We propose a new explanation: a uniform decline in real risk-free interest rates can have heterogeneous spatial effects on house values. Falling real safe rates disproportionately push up prices in large agglomerations where initial rent-price ratios are low, leading to housing market polarization on the national level. (JEL E43, R21, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 国内房价差异的扩大是美国和国际上备受争议的趋势。利用15个发达经济体的新长期区域数据，我们表明，将价格离散度增长与租金离散度联系起来的标准解释与一个重要的事实相矛盾：租金离散度的增长远低于价格离散度。我们提出了一种新的解释：实际无风险利率的普遍下降可能对房价产生异质性的空间影响。实际安全利率的下降不成比例地推高了大城市群的价格，这些地区的初始租金-价格比率较低，从而导致国家层面的住房市场极化。(JEL E43, R21, R31)

articles.title_en: The Marginal Disutility from Corruption in Social Programs: Evidence from Program Administrators and Beneficiaries
articles.title_cn: 社会项目中腐败的边际负效用：来自项目管理者与受益者的证据
articles.abstract_en: Concerns about fraud in welfare programs are common arguments worldwide against such programs. We conducted a survey experiment with over 28,000 welfare program administrators and over 19,000 beneficiaries in Indonesia to elicit the “marginal disutility from corruption”—the trade-off between more generous social assistance and losses due to corruption. Merely mentioning corruption reduced perceived program success, equivalent to distributing more than 26 percentage points less aid. However, respondents were not sensitive to the amount of corruption—respondents were willing to trade off $2 of additional losses for an additional $1 distributed to beneficiaries. Program administrators and beneficiaries had similar assessments. (JEL D73, H53, I32, I38, O15, O17)
articles.abstract_cn: 对福利项目中欺诈的担忧是世界范围内反对此类项目的常见论据。我们在印度尼西亚对超过28,000名福利项目管理者和超过19,000名受益者进行了一项调查实验，以引出“腐败的边际负效用”——即更慷慨的社会援助与腐败造成的损失之间的权衡。仅仅提及腐败就会降低感知的项目成功率，相当于少分配超过26个百分点的援助。然而，受访者对腐败程度并不敏感——受访者愿意为额外分配给受益者的1美元承担2美元的额外损失。项目管理者和受益者的评估相似。(JEL D73, H53, I32, I38, O15, O17)

articles.title_en: Can Financial Incentives to Firms Improve Apprenticeship Training? Experimental Evidence from Ghana
articles.title_cn: 对企业的财务激励能否改善学徒培训？来自加纳的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We use a field experiment to test whether financial incentives can improve the quality of apprenticeship training. Trainers (firm owners) in the treatment group participated in a tournament incentive scheme where they received a payment based on their apprentices’ rank-order performance on a skills assessment. Trainers in the control group received a fixed payment based on their apprentices’ participation in the assessment. Performance on the assessment was higher in the treatment group. Two years later, treated apprentices scored 0.15σ higher on a low-stakes oral skills test and earned 24 percent more in total earnings, driven by higher self-employment profits. (JEL D22, D82, J24, J31, M53, O12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项实地实验来检验财务激励能否提高学徒培训的质量。处理组的培训师（企业主）参与了一项锦标赛激励计划，他们根据学徒在技能评估中的排名表现获得报酬。对照组的培训师则根据学徒参与评估的情况获得固定报酬。处理组在评估中的表现更高。两年后，接受处理的学徒在低风险口头技能测试中得分高出0.15个标准差，总收入高出24%，这主要得益于更高的自雇利润。（JEL D22, D82, J24, J31, M53, O12）

articles.title_en: Cash and Conflict: Large-Scale Experimental Evidence from Niger
articles.title_cn: 现金与冲突：来自尼日尔的大规模实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Conflict undermines development, while adverse economic shocks, in turn, can increase conflict risk. Policy interventions such as cash transfers could attenuate conflict risk by raising poor households’ opportunity costs. However, cash transfers may also trigger looting, and expanding government programs may attract attacks to undermine state legitimacy. We study the net effect across these forces based on the large-scale randomization of a government-led cash transfer program and georeferenced conflict events. Cash transfers did not yield greater pacification but—if anything—triggered a short-term increase in conflict events (by 0.63 percentage points), substantially driven by terrorist attacks by foreign rebel groups. (JEL D72, D74, H53, I38, O15, O17)
articles.abstract_cn: 冲突阻碍发展，而不利的经济冲击反过来又会增加冲突风险。诸如现金转移之类的政策干预可以通过提高贫困家庭的机会成本来降低冲突风险。然而，现金转移也可能引发抢劫，而且扩大政府项目可能招致攻击以削弱国家合法性。我们基于一个政府主导的现金转移项目的大规模随机化和地理参照冲突事件来研究这些力量的净效应。现金转移并未带来更大的和平效果，反而——如果有的话——在短期内增加了冲突事件（增加了0.63个百分点），这主要由外国叛乱团体的恐怖袭击驱动。（JEL D72, D74, H53, I38, O15, O17）
